title: Contingency Conversion Terms by First Notice Pack Size
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Schedule of Conversion Terms

A debt sent letters under the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs may be converted to contingency collection. Each pack size fixes three conversion terms: the window after the debtor's series ends within which the debt may be converted, whether conversion waits for the full series to be sent, and the percentage points taken off the client's Primary Placement contingency rate on converted debts.

| Pack | Conversion window (calendar days after the series ends) | Conversion only after the full series has been sent | Discount off the Primary Placement contingency rate (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 30 | Yes | 0 |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 30 | Yes | 0 |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 45 | Yes | 2 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 45 | Yes | 3 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 60 | No | 5 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 60 | No | 5 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The **discount** is stated in percentage points, not as a percentage of the rate. A discount of 0 means converted debts carry the client's Primary Placement contingency rate unchanged.
2. "**Yes**" in the full-series column means a debtor may be converted only after the full series has been sent; "**No**" means the pack sets no such requirement.

## Points of judgement

| Pack sizes | Does conversion wait for the full series? | Points off the Primary Placement rate |
|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit and 150-Unit Programs | Yes | none |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | Yes | 2 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | Yes | 3 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit and 2500-Unit Programs | No | 5 |

Illustration on hypothetical figures: for a client whose Primary Placement contingency rate is a hypothetical 30 percent, a discount of 2 percentage points gives a rate of 28 percent on the converted debt.
